decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 3 - 3.	All new external finishes in respect of all the works hereby approved 9and any othet incidental works to be carried out in connection ) shall match the existing building in respect of materials used, detailed executive and finished appearance.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the side extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The extension garden room hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 29 Kinnaird Avenue.
Condition : 7 - All work to trees shall be carried out to BS Specification 3998 (As Amended).
description: Erection of single storey side extension, alteration to roof and extension to garden room of dwellinghouse
